title: Static attributes of the gauge basins (HydroBASINS)
source: HydroBASINS v1c level 12 (Lehner & Grill 2013, Hydrol. Process. 27, 2171-2186; HydroSHEDS licence: free use with citation, https://www.hydrosheds.org); elevation: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (ESA); forcing: ERA5 (Copernicus Climate Change Service) via ARCO-ERA5 (Google Cloud public dataset)
license: CC-BY 4.0 (ERA5); Copernicus DEM licence (free basis for the general public; terms at https://dataspace.copernicus.eu/explore-data/data-collections/copernicus-contributing-missions/collections-description/COP-DEM); HydroSHEDS licence (HydroBASINS)
units: area_km2: km2 (polygon, spherical equal-area); elev_*_m: m; hypso_m: 101 elevations (m) at the 0..100 % cos(lat)-weighted area quantiles of the polygon; frac_above_2000m: 0..1; centroid: degrees (polygon centroid); box: polygon bounding box (S, N, W, E)
box_note: cuenca delineada de HydroBASINS nivel 12 (Lehner & Grill 2013) aguas arriba del polígono de la estación
basin_note: delineated upstream of the level-12 polygon holding the gauge: the polygon extends past the gauge point; upstream polygons with a different NEXT_SINK (endorheic, excluded from UP_AREA) are left out
elevation_note: cos(lat)-weighted over the GLO-30 raster decimated to 0.00833 degrees, cells inside the polygon
